14: "We place him in nidui" — and this is specifically regarding a chovel and similar cases, where we place [him] in nidui because there is no other mamon component. Because otherwise, everyone would injure and damage his fellow. But not for kefel and daled v'hei. And so the Sma ruled in se'if katan 11, and so the Maharshal ruled in siman 6, see there.
